newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MONDAY MIXED ON HARD UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MONDAY MIXED ON HARD UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar ended Monday's interbank session firmer on pound sterling and the mark but registered losses against the U.S. dollar and the rand on increased importer demand, dealers said.
"Due to some import orders, it was largely a buyers market today and market sentiment is that import pressure should continue for quite a while now," one dealer commented.
"We saw a bit of the Reserve Bank (come in to bail out the local unit) but soon afterwards, people were buying in the market again. It was a bit on the shortish side," another said.
The Zimbabwe currency finished the day at 10.7450/7650 against the U.S. dollar, three cents down from it's previous close last Friday and was also easier on the rand at 2.3300/3500 from 2.3170/3240.
It was however stronger at 18.0300/0500 from 18.0560/1000 against sterling and edged up to 7.0800/1000 on the mark from 7.1370/1530.
